scope: Manual identification of Cafe 9 and toilet 15 from source-context agreement. Roof observations are not surveyed wall footprints or heights.
method: Match club descriptions and club-linked course-guide amenity icons to path, green, tee and pond context in the native 0.16 m 2025 orthophoto. Manually read main-roof edge pixels; convert through unchanged raster geotransform. No matching OSM building in retained course context.

observations.name: Cafe 9 between green 9 and tee 10
observations.locationConfidence: high contextual agreement; footprint precision approximate
observations.geometryUncertainty: Manually read visible roof perimeter only; allow approximately 1-2 m for edge reading, overhang and roof displacement. Northern covered sales projection is visible but not included in this polygon; walls and heights are not measured.

guide.observation: Cafe, toilet and tap symbols placed over a rectangular building behind green 9 alongside the path to tee 10. Path bend, pond and roof location agree with the georeferenced orthophoto.
guide.rights: Public viewing; no derivative or redistribution grant found. Local reference only; raw bytes must not ship.

corroboration.claim: Current guest page locates a kiosk between holes 9 and 10.
Historical account places the 1991 rest hut between green 9 and tee 10; later named Cafe 9.
2022 report describes refurbishment and unattended operation of Cafe 9.
Anniversary history records a roof over the sales area in 2015 and self-service in 2022.

appearanceSupported: Long narrow detached structure with dark pitched roof, ridge along the long axis.
Smaller covered extension at the north end; light wall slivers and surrounding paved approach visible.
Main roof is roughly 20 m east of red tee 10 and 46 m southwest of green 9 center.
appearanceUnresolved: Wall material, actual facade colour, exact doors and service-opening arrangement.
Exact wall footprint, eave/ridge heights, north sales-canopy extent and present furnishings.
Guide symbols establish services at this location but do not show internal layout.

observations.name: Toilet and water point beside tee 15
observations.locationConfidence: high contextual agreement; footprint precision approximate
observations.geometryUncertainty: Manually read small visible roof only. Approximately 1 m edge/overhang/displacement uncertainty is material at this scale; walls and heights are not measured.

guide.observation: Toilet and tap icons at the course-road/path junction northwest of red tee 15, matching the small roof and visible water-point area in the 2025 orthophoto.
guide.rights: Public viewing; no derivative or redistribution grant found. Local reference only; raw bytes must not ship.

corroboration.claim: Report dated 2022-12-16 says a toilet is being built at the existing tap near the start of hole 15, for use the following spring.
Anniversary history records a new water-flush toilet at tee 15 in 2023.

appearanceSupported: Small approximately square roof with dark grey surface; a light wall face is visible.
Roof stands immediately east of the road and west of the curved course path, approximately 15 m west-northwest of red tee 15.
Water-point or washing fixtures are visible just south of the roof, agreeing with the text and guide tap icon.
appearanceUnresolved: Actual wall material and colour, exact roof pitch, doors, signage and fixture shapes.
Exact wall footprint and eave/ridge height. Any detailed facade would be an authored estimate.

excludedClaims: No exact matching OSM building ID was found. Observation IDs are newly assigned review IDs, not source database IDs.
No height measurement, current condition after 2025-05-31, interior layout or exact facade reconstruction follows from these sources.
